storyline.governing_thought: Launch Copilot in Q4 2027, after the mobile rewrite, in a $12-a-seat Pro plan, not a $149 add-on

next_steps.action: Approve the Pro plan at $12 more per seat and retire the $149 add-on proposal
Read the Q4 2026 win rate against Routewise and confirm the Q4 2027 timing
Confirm the 14 engineers move to Copilot as soon as the mobile rewrite ships
Run the Pro price test with beta accounts and measure productivity in non-volunteers
Set the request allowance and pack prices, and prepare the inference renegotiation

problem.statement: Should Brightwork launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and if so, how should it be packaged and priced to lift NRR from 101% to 105% by 2028 with gross margin at or above 75%?
problem.decision_maker: CEO and executive team: launch timing, package and price
success_criteria: Net revenue retention rises from 101% to 105% by 2028
Company gross margin stays at or above 75%
The trade-off with the mobile app rewrite is made explicitly
problem.accuracy: Order of magnitude (±25%), enough to rank the options
out_of_scope: Changes to the Core plan price
Engineering beyond the 60 engineers in the plan

one_day_answer.situation: Brightwork has built Dispatch Copilot, and a 12-week beta suggests it saves dispatchers time
one_day_answer.complication: Routewise now includes AI in its Pro plan, but only 14% of beta accounts paid $149, and launching delays the mobile rewrite customers ask for
one_day_answer.resolution: Package Copilot in a Pro plan priced per seat with a request allowance, and launch it after the mobile rewrite unless the win rate shows AI cannot wait
